dct_description_sm:
This was a running bibliography of the Modern South Arabian languages, which had been compiled by Janet Watson with Miranda Morris since 2013.

The bibliography developed out of the Documentation and Ethnolinguistic Analysis of Modern South Arabian project, funded by the Leverhulme Trust, UK between January 2013 and December 2016. In the first two years, it was compiled with help from Domenyk Eades. It was updated whenever significant new publications appeared or were discovered.

This version was added on 28th December 2025. After posting, the final bibliography was published in Kervan - International Journal of African and Asiatic Studies 29/1.

The published version can be accessed from: https://doi.org/10.13135/1825-263X/13176.

It is hoped that other researchers of MSAL will continue with the bibliography.
